category_title: Socially isolated students with high-risk behaviors and peer-group alienation
scenario_title: Navigating intensive supervision and control in Timeout-class
minimal_context: Patrick is working on electronic equipment in the Timeout-class under the intensive supervision of his teacher.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Patrick, it is time for our afternoon activity. Please stay at the table where I can see you while you work on the electronic equipment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can fix this, and I can give you support with the other electronic equipment too. I could even sell you my sound-card if you want to buy it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Thank you, but let's just focus on finishing the current assignment right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm doing the work, but we need to change the rules about me being kept in here all day. I want to negotiate my schedule so I have more control over what I do.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: That is not something we can change. You have to remain in the Timeout-class under supervision.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not accepting that. I already spoke to the local school representative and the police about this. I am also asking the researchers for argumentative support so that you and my parents will be convinced to let me shoot at the shooting club.

task.content: Participating in daily activities and managing the formally given relation of dependance and control

context.environment: Timeout-class with intensive supervision where students are almost never out of sight of the teacher
context.materials: Valuables (mobile, cigarettes, lighter) locked in by teachers; electronic equipment, sound-card, table-tennis, meals, wood
context.social_setting: Two teachers and 6-8 students at maximum; spend their breaks inside the school, cook their meals and have lunch with the teachers
context.time_context: In the morning and during the day

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Experiencing massive control and the formally given relation of dependance
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Mobilizes all possible social resources to convince teachers and parents to be allowed to shoot at a shooting club; speakes to the local school representative as well as the police and even asks the researchers for argumentative support
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Seeking to resymmetrize the formally given relation of dependance and control

behavior_patterns.condition: When experiencing unexpected empowerment and opportunities for social participation
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Sells several gadgets to the teachers (e.g his sound-card) and gives them support with electronic equipment
